create_random_agent: create a RandomAgent instance with a player id, number of actions, and optional name
run_random_agent_step: run the RandomAgent step method to select a random legal action from the current time step
test_random_agent_uniform: test that the RandomAgent selects actions uniformly from the set of legal actions
review_random_agent_step: review the RandomAgent step method to verify it returns StepOutput with action and probability distribution
summarize_random_agent: summarize the RandomAgent class as an RL agent that follows a uniform distribution over legal actions
